q: (On the night of Qadr the Qur'aan was brought down from the “Lowhul Mahfoodh” to the heaven above the earth. It was from here that Jibra'eel ﵊ brought the Qur'aan to Rasulullaah ﷺ over a period of twenty-three years.)
v.s: Indeed, We sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down during the Night of Decree.
v.c: Indeed, ˹it is˺ We ˹Who˺ sent this ˹Quran˺ down on the Night of Glory.
v.h: The Night the Quran Was Revealed

q: Do you know what is the night of Qadr
(night of Taqdeer or night of Power)?
v.s: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?
v.c: And what will make you realize what the Night of Glory is?

q: night of Qadr is better than
(Therefore, the person who engages in Ibaadah during the night of Qadr will be rewarded more than a person who engages in Ibaadah for a thousand months that do not include a night of Qadr.)
v.s: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
v.c: The Night of Glory is better than a thousand months.

q: on this night by the command of their Rabb.
(It is on this night that the angels with duties on earth receive their instructions for the coming year.)
v.s: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.
v.c: That night the angels and the ˹holy˺ spirit descend, by the permission of their Lord, for every ˹decreed˺ matter.

v.s: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.
v.c: It is all peace until the break of dawn.
